title: Speedmaster 1200 (Rally Edition)
description: The Triumph Speedmaster 1200 (Rally Edition) is combines low-slung road presence with generous low-end torque rumble, positioned in the Urban Roadster segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 1200cc engine generating 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 228 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
